notablePrerequisites: You've had three or more nontoken creatures enter under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Thranduil using Tromell's ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thranduil for each nontoken creature that entered under your control this turn.
Activate Thranduil using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Thranduil using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thranduil using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
